scene sky
You know — the one I’m not having sex with.
And while I do patiently await the day that changes, now probably isn’t a good time to see if she wants to head back to her room and permanently modify our relationship.
I say, knowing full well that I’ve been more hesitant with her than I am with most.
But in a sense, Rin is kind of like the daughter I had before actually having a daughter. If you ignore the sexual tension at least.
What I mean is that if we were anywhere closer to the same age, I wouldn’t hesitate to have called her a best friend in the beginning.
Now...not so much.
And we both know that. And that’s fine.
But the lingering memory of that connection still...well, you know, lingers. And I feel it most when we’re alone.
scene rinsenseiwalking1
That just doesn’t happen as much as it used to.
: The cafe? Really? You seriously thought that was a good idea?
: You should know by now that I don’t always think things through before deciding to engage in sexual intercourse.
: Why are you calling it sexual intercourse now? Do you think formal language is going to make me any less mad at you?
: Are you mad at me for endangering your livelihood? Or are you mad at me for endangering your livelihood while you weren’t around to watch?
: The first one, dweeb. If I wanted to watch you bone anyone, all I’d have to do is ask.
: Or hide behind a privacy curtain in the hospital room that Ayane has in her mansion for some reason.
scene rinsenseiwalking2
: You...knew about that?...
: I may have found out after the fact. And I may have just forgotten that I was probably not supposed to tell you I knew? I can’t really remember.
scene rinsenseiwalking3
: Welp. There goes ever making eye contact with you again.
: To be fair, it’s not that much different from that night in the hotel where we listened to each other have sex in opposite rooms.
: I guess not when you put it that way. But that was basically just me listening to Nodoka since you’re quiet as all hell when you’re hooking up with my classmates.
scene rinsenseiwalking4
: Also, what the hell is going on with Sana?!

: Has she always been like that and just hiding it from us?! Because I am learning many things about her way too quickly and can’t even talk about most of them due to a legally-binding agreement I recently made!
: A what?
: Doesn’t matter! Sana! Horny! Yes or no?!
scene rinsenseiwalking5
: I think she was hiding it, but...I’m not really sure. This side of her is new to me. And that time in the hospital room was the first time we ever did anything, I think.
: I just wish I could remember more of it.
: That was the first time? Really?
: Yeah. I don’t even know how it happened.
scene rinsenseiwalking6
: That’s...a little concerning then. Because you weren’t really all that...stable just before that happened...
: Did Sana maybe, like...take advantage of you?
: She’s under five feet tall and weighs about the same as a large bag of rice. I’m not sure how much “advantage” she could take even if she wanted to.
: Maybe...it just seems kind of weird since-
: Don’t worry about it, Rin. All things considered, I’ve taken advantage of way more people. If she saw an opportunity and took it, good for her.
: Besides, it’s not like you had any issue with it in the moment if you were fingering yourself behind a curtain.
scene rinsenseiwalking7
: Definitely not my proudest moment, that’s for sure...but at least I didn’t get caught having sex in a fucking cafe, you friggin’ idiot.
scene rinsenseiwalking8
: Ugh! Everything’s so messed up now! Take me back to when I was a lowly coffee-slinger with a creepy teacher only boning like two girls I knew instead of fifty.
: Do you even know fifty girls? In fact, which girls do you know about?
scene rinsenseiwalking9
: Chika and Futaba for sure because I hear about it all the time.
: Futaba talks about that kind of stuff with you?
scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Of course. We’re practically sisters, remember?
: She doesn’t go into nearly as much detail as Chika does, though.
: That must be hard for you, huh?
: You have no fucking idea.
: Anyone else?
scene rinsenseiwalking9
: Well...Sana, obviously. Nodoka, obviously. Then there’s Haruka. But they’re the only ones I know for sure.
: Are you suspicious of anyone else?
: I’m suspicious of everyone else. But I’d be mega shocked if you weren’t also having sex with Ayane. And probably Makoto too since those two have been riding you since day one.
: Both literally and figuratively. You’re right.
: Guess that’s that, then.
scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Noriko? Kirin?
: Noriko, no. Kirin, yes.
scene rinsenseiwalking11
: Noriko’s a no?! Really?!
: Are you not surprised about the Kirin part?
: I kind of just assume Kirin has sex with everyone, so not really. Why not Noriko? She’s head over heels for you, man.

: That’s kind of why. Noriko’s brilliant and driven and I feel a little weird about dragging her into the same pit of quicksand I’m dragging everyone else into. Plus, she has her own stuff going on as well.
scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Huh...interesting. Why are you just coming out and telling me all of this, though? Is the new Sensei trying to be more honest or something?
: It’s more that I just don’t feel the need to hide anything from you anymore. You’ve done more than enough to keep my secrets.
scene rinsenseiwalking12
: Hell no I haven’t. I totally let the Chika stuff slip to Otoha that one time and I still feel terrible about it. You’re insane for telling me literally anything after that.
: Maybe. But you haven’t let anything slip to Chika and she’s the dangerous one.
scene rinsenseiwalking13

: That’s precisely why I haven’t let anything slip to her. I don’t want you to end up dead in a ditch somewhere. She’s so in love with you that it’s literally crazy. Like, literally crazy. Almost Ami level.
: She’s not that bad. But yeah, she can go a little overboard sometimes. Which makes me feel kind of bad since I haven’t really been spending much time with her lately.
scene rinsenseiwalking10
: I’m supposed to hang out with her later if you want to come.
: I was gonna meet up with her once my shift was over, but I left my phone at the dorm and can’t tell her that I will never have any shift ever again and am free for the rest of my life.
: I’m sure the cafe will be fine. Having it closed permanently would be too huge of a plot divergence and the narrative branching would probably start to get out of hand.
: Are you boning Molly too? Because that line makes it sound like you’ve been boning Molly.
: She may or may not have put my penis in her mouth recently.
scene rinsenseiwalking14
: Good for you, Molly. You’ve finally made it.
: Not the reaction I was expecting, but cool.
scene rinsenseiwalking15

: Think you’ll ever make a choice, Sensei? Think you’ve got what it takes to just pick one of them and let the rest find someone else to fall for instead of dooming them to the life of regularly banging a gigolo?
: My answer to that’s a little different now than it would have been a year ago...
: I’m still rooting for Chika if that day ever does come. Sorry, Futaba.
: You just don’t want me to die.
: You’re not wrong.
: It’s kind of interesting how far we’ve come, isn’t it? That just a little while ago, we were both gunning for Chika’s affection.
scene rinsenseiwalking16
: And I was failing miserably to make her look at me while you were sticking your fingers inside of her.
: And now you’re encouraging me to stay with her while I’m putting my fingers inside a bunch of people.
: I remember when someone used to put their fingers inside of me. Those were the days.
: I could lend you a hand with that if you really need me to.
: Tempting. It might spare me the embarrassment of having to do it myself behind a curtain again. But for Chika’s sake, I will abstain. And for everyone’s sake, so should you.
: But what about yours?
scene rinsenseiwalking17
: Don’t worry about me. I can keep using the same strategy I’ve been using ever since I first encountered the proper usage of a detachable shower-head.
: Guess things will just stay the same then.
: Guess so.
: But we’re happy that way, aren’t we?
: Are we?
scene rinsenseiwalking18
: I’m smiling, aren’t I?
: For now. But I’m sure that smile will begin to fade in twenty minutes when you meet up with Chika and she starts inevitably ranting about my penis again.
scene rinsenseiwalking17
: I’ve heard so much about your penis by now that I’m starting to see it in my dreams. Can I use your phone?
scene rinsenseiwalking19
: What a strange segue. Maybe don’t repeat that to Chika.
scene rinsenseiwalking20
: Sometimes I dream about your penis inside of her.
: I’m pretty sure that you’re supposed to involve yourself in sex dreams.
: Yeah, but my dreams are basically a giant cesspool of depravity now. Sometimes I’m involved. Sometimes, you’re boning Chika in my old bedroom while I’m downstairs playing checkers with my grandma.
: I don’t even know what your old bedroom looks like.
: I don’t even know what my grandma looks like. Never met her. Why is your wallpaper just Ami a million times?
: I guess because she didn’t like the picture of Makoto.
scene rinsenseiwalking21
: What picture of Makoto?
: Ask her about it. I’m sure she’d love to tell you.
scene rinsenseiwalking22
: I’ll keep that in mind for when I go back to school on Monday. For now, I must give Chika the jumpscare of her life by calling her from your phone and pretending to be another woman.
: Please don’t. She knows where I live.
if nikinudetrade == False:
scene black
Rin gives a Chika a call and, without pretending to be a mysterious lover of mine, quickly explains why she’s calling her from my phone instead of hers.
The two of them talk for a minute or two and reaffirm whatever plans they made for this afternoon before I get roped into speaking to my “girlfriend” as well.
Chika does her best to try and get me to join them, but...having something else in mind, I decide it’s best to let her and Rin hang out alone instead.
I’m still not ready to be the type of person Chika needs me to be, but...that’s fine. Because she has other people who can be there for her in my place.
Rin and I part ways after making it back to the dorms, but she promises to try and keep me updated on anything happening with Koi Cafe as soon as she gets an update.
As I watch her disappear into the building, I feel a strange sense of relief. Relief that, even with all that’s changed as of late, what I have with her seems mostly the same.
And maybe things will stay that way forever. Maybe they won’t.
I’m just glad that she’s a part of my life.
And I will do my very best to not get caught having sex with her boss in public anymore.

scene rinsenseiwalking23
: Hey, since when do you have Otoha’s number? I didn’t realize you two were cool now.
: Have we ever been uncool? Because we’ve never been close, but-
scene rinsenseiwalking24
: Wait...Actually, can I have my phone back for a second?
scene rinsenseiwalking25
: Rin? Can I have my phone? I just have to check something.
: I don’t like that you’re very quiet all of a sudden. It makes me think you might have seen something. Which, if you did, there’s probably a very good explanation for.
: Ugh...
: You opened up her messages, didn’t you?
: Why?
scene rinsenseiwalking26
: Shouldn’t I be the one asking that question?...
: I...forgot that was in there.
: You forgot?...
: Why did you open up her messages in the first place? I thought you were just going to call Chika.
scene rinsenseiwalking27

: Because I’m nosy and wanted to see if you were talking about me so I could tease you about it! I had no idea I’d find this! Why did she send you this?! And why did you send her someone else’s boobs?!
: Is this really a conversation we need to have when you shouldn’t have ever seen that at all?...
scene rinsenseiwalking28
: You’re right...I shouldn’t have seen this at all.
: But you shouldn’t have gotten it at all.
: And if we’re really friends, you’ll want to give me an explanation.

: Because I can ignore this if I have to...I know I invaded your privacy and I know how messed up that is. But I really hope you’re not going to make me ignore it...because this is way worse and you know that.
: That’s why you keep looking away.
: Talk to me, Sensei.
: Why do you have this?...
scene rinsenseiwalking29
: We traded.
: Whose idea was it?
: Does it really matter?...
: It does.
: It was my idea.
: So you specifically asked Otoha for this picture?...And she went along with it in exchange for one that you had?...
: That’s right...
: And how do you feel now that you’ve been caught?
: Not great, to be honest. I’m getting caught in things more often than I’d like lately. I’m getting too careless.
: Do you jerk off to it?
: What?
: Do you look at this picture of me and jerk off?
: Uhh...
: Just answer the question.
: I mean...
: I wouldn’t have asked for it if I wasn’t going to do that.
scene rinsenseiwalking30
: Hah...
: Is this really the type of relationship we have?...
: You secretly touching yourself to pictures of me? Me secretly touching myself while listening to you hook up with my friends?
: What are we even doing anymore?
: Being...perverts, I guess?
: I guess, yeah...
: I would have sent you one if you just asked, you know...
: Like...you may have had to talk me into it, but...
: Going behind my back and getting this from my ex is just...sleazy. From both of you.
: I didn’t really think it through, Rin. It was a spur of the moment thing. And I wasn’t going to ask you for something like this when-
scene rinsenseiwalking31
: I’m really disappointed in you, Sensei.
if rinbetrayed == True:
: After all we’ve been through together, you’re still doing things like this. You’re still letting me down.
: You never change, do you?
else:
: After all we’ve been through...you turn around and do this? Really? To me?
: Is this what I get for disappearing on you for so long? For chasing after someone else instead of you? Is this payback?
: It’s nothing like that, Rin...I’ve never blamed you for going after Otoha.
: So this decision was based 100%% on lust?
: Lust and the fact that I will always be a terrible person who does terrible things, even to those I care about the most.
: You care about me the most?
: You’re definitely up there.
scene rinsenseiwalking32
: Hah...
: You could get in serious trouble for having this, you know. Do I really need to be the one to tell you that?
: Then maybe...don’t stand out here in the open holding it up for anyone who walks by to see?
: I don’t care about other people. I wanted you to see this and me at the same time so you could think about how fucked up this is.
: I’m sorry, Rin. Really. And I know there’s nothing I can do to make it up to you, but-
scene rinsenseiwalking33
: Send me one.
: ...Excuse me?
: Send me a picture.
: Like...of myself?
: Tit for tat. If you’re going to have a picture of me, it’s only fair that I get a picture of you as well. That way, you can’t hold it over my head.
: Do you really think I’d do something like that to you?
: No. But I didn’t think you’d trade for my nudes either and look where we are now.
: I’ve never sent one before.
scene rinsenseiwalking34
: Wait, really?
: Yeah. I always just get them. I never send anything back.
: And people keep sending them to you regardless?
: Yeah. I’m surprised I’ve gotten away with it for as long as I have, to be honest.
scene rinsenseiwalking35
: Then I guess I get to be your first!
: Do I...really have to do this?
: Tit for tat, Sensei!
scene rinsenseiwalking36
: And I solemnly swear I definitely won’t do anything lewd while looking at it.
: I’m not sure if I believe you.
: I’m not sure if you should.
: Is this really the only way to-
: Yes.
: And I’ll be completely forgiven once I-
: Yes.
: This seems way too easy.
: That’s what friends are for.
: Masturbating to each other?
: I masturbate to all of my friends. It’s an unsung perk of being bi. The big change now is that I won’t just have to use my imagination for you anymore.
: And how often do you think of me exactly?
: How often do you think of me?
: Pretty often.
: Same here.
: That’s cool.
: Yeah. I guess it is.
: I’m gonna be honest, I haven’t felt this tempted to touch you since that time I walked in on you changing.
: I’m gonna be honest, I touched myself when you left that night.
: Why don’t we just...you know...
: Do it?
: Yeah.
: Honestly...I’ve been wondering the same thing a lot lately.
scene rinsenseiwalking37
: I’m single now...and I’m not actively chasing after anyone.
: But, at the same time, there are a lot of people who I really love that really love you. And we’re friends. Which is why I’ve been content with just masturbating.
: But I think that one day, I might have to make a decision too. Just like you will. And if we both make the same decision at the same time, then...
: Maybe we’ll finally stop keeping our hands to ourselves?
scene rinsenseiwalking38
: But for now...that’s kind of what we have to do if we don’t want to hurt anyone.
: We could always just keep it a secret.
: You mean like you kept this picture a secret?
: Fair point.
: I guess we just...keep our lust for one another confined to the digital world then?
: You gonna ask me directly next time?
: There can be a next time?
: Depends on what you send me. Because I’m the type who actually sends things back.
: Okay. I think it’s time for you to call Chika for real. I’m getting a little too tempted right now.
: Same here, homie.
: That word takes on a whole new meaning with you staring at me like that.
: That makes sense.
scene black
: I think it might have one now.
Rin calls Chika and subsequently leaves me behind...but not before telling me to not even think of sending her anything until later tonight.

I can only imagine how Chika would react if Rin just so happened to get an inappropriate picture of me while the two of them were hanging out. Especially when Chika has yet to ever receive one herself.
So for now, I guess I’m off the hook — but I’m on a different one.
I can’t just keep denying the way I feel for this girl that I so obviously want to conquer...but I can’t just do it either.
The time needs to be right...but time is so frequently fucked up here that the sheer concept of that sounds impossible.
I don’t know what I’m supposed to do.
I don’t know anything anymore.
Just that I need to take care of something right now.
You masturbate in a public bathroom! Hooray!
